title: A wick is not a break
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The Daily and 4H are still up. Price swept the overnight low and bounced. Decide whether the bounce is a reason to buy.
intro.advanced: 09:50 ET. Sweep and a bounce. Mark what matters and decide.

whyNot.label: buying the bounce
whyNot.why: The bounce never closed above the last 5m high; it only wicked through it. Without a body close, structure hasn't shifted, so the sweep is a candidate and not yet an entry.

whyNot.label: shorting the failed pop
whyNot.why: The higher timeframes are up. A failed bounce is a reason to wait, not a reason to fight the trend.

reference.summary: A sweep of the overnight low with a bounce that only wicked through the last 5m high. No displacement and no body close means no confirmation. Wait for one, or stand aside.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are still making higher highs and higher lows; nothing here changed that.

decision.why: There is a sweep, but nothing confirms it: the bounce is a wick, not a close. Standing aside or waiting for a real shift is the position; entering is a guess.

take.why: The location is fine and the confirmation is missing.

draw.why: The previous day high is still the pool above; the trade just isn't ready.

annotations.label: Overnight low 21,145.25
annotations.why: Obvious sell-side liquidity, taken at the open.

annotations.label: Sweep low 21,121.25
annotations.why: The extreme of the sweep; a close below it kills the idea.

annotations.label: Last 5m high 21,203.25
annotations.why: The pop traded through this and closed back under it. That's a wick, not a break of structure.
annotations.whyNot: A wick through a level is a probe. Structure shifts when a candle body closes through it.

annotations.label: Previous day high 21,365.25
annotations.why: Where this would be heading if it confirmed.

confluences.label: Daily and 4H trending up
confluences.why: The location is on the right side.

confluences.label: A break of the last 5m high
confluences.why: Only a wick went through. No candle closed above it.

confluences.label: A strong bounce off the low
confluences.why: A bounce is not displacement; it didn't take out a structural high.

confluences.label: Inside the NY AM window
confluences.why: Timing is right and says nothing about whether it confirmed.

confluences.label: Previous day high above
confluences.why: A target means nothing until there's an entry.

lookFor: A body close through the swing is the confirmation. A wick is a probe.
A sweep tells you where to look. It doesn't tell you to buy.
If you'd be entering on hope that it confirms, that's the trade to skip.
